name: Dedupe YAML tags is case sensitive and will use your default format for tags.
before:
---
tags: [computer, research, computer, Computer]
aliases:
  - Title 1
  - Title2
---
after:
---
tags: [computer, research, Computer]
aliases:
  - Title 1
  - Title2
---

name: Dedupe YAML aliases is case sensitive and will use your default format for aliases.
before:
---
tags: [computer, research]
aliases:
  - Title 1
  - Title2
  - Title 1
  - Title2
  - Title 3
---
after:
---
tags: [computer, research]
aliases:
  - Title 1
  - Title2
  - Title 3
---

name: Dedupe YAML array keys is case sensitive and will try to preserve the original array format.
before:
---
tags: [computer, research]
aliases:
  - Title 1
  - Title2
arr1: [val, val1, val, val2, Val]
arr2:
  - Val
  - Val
  - val
  - val2
  - Val2
---
after:
---
tags: [computer, research]
aliases:
  - Title 1
  - Title2
arr1: [val, val1, val2, Val]
arr2:
  - Val
  - val
  - val2
  - Val2
---

name: Dedupe YAML respects list of keys to not remove duplicates of for normal arrays (keys to ignore is just `arr2` for this example)
before:
---
tags: [computer, research]
aliases:
  - Title 1
  - Title2
arr1: [val, val1, val, val2, Val]
arr2:
  - Val
  - Val
  - val
  - val2
  - Val2
---
after:
---
tags: [computer, research]
aliases:
  - Title 1
  - Title2
arr1: [val, val1, val2, Val]
arr2:
  - Val
  - Val
  - val
  - val2
  - Val2
---

name: Deduping escaped YAML array keys should not throw an error
Deduping YAML arrays should properly handle escaped values being the same and prefer the first of all values that are found to be the same
